blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Cross-docking is a clever way to move goods without really storing them. A truck arrives on one side of the warehouse. The goods are unloaded, sorted, and almost immediately loaded onto another truck on the other side. They never sit on a shelf.

The benefit is speed and a lower storage cost. Products spend hours, not days, inside the warehouse.

The downside is that it only works when everything is well coordinated. A missed inbound truck breaks the whole flow. Cross-docking is the art of moving goods without keeping them.

items.q: What happens to the goods after they are unloaded?
options: They are sent back to the supplier
They are counted and left on the floor
They are sorted and loaded onto another truck
They are stored on a shelf for days
items.why: "unloaded, sorted, and almost immediately loaded onto another truck".

items.q: How long do products stay in the warehouse?
items.why: "Products spend hours, not days, inside the warehouse."

items.q: What is the main benefit of cross-docking?
items.why: "The benefit is speed and a lower storage cost."

items.q: The text suggests that cross-docking needs…
items.why: Inferência: "it only works when everything is well coordinated" — depende de tempo e coordenação.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: Goods should stay on the shelf for a long time
A late truck can cause problems
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo defende NÃO guardar os produtos na prateleira.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver mostrar o cross-dock a um novo supervisor. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the cross-dock. Let me show you how it works. It is really simple.

Look at that door on the left. The inbound trucks arrive there. The team unloads the sugar pallets fast. Then they sort them — this group goes to São Paulo, that group goes to Santos. There is no shelf here. We do not store anything.

On the right side, the outbound trucks are already waiting. We load the pallets straight onto them. From inbound to outbound, the sugar is here for less than ninety minutes. Hours, not days.

But listen — timing is everything. If one inbound truck is late, the whole flow stops. The outbound truck waits, and we lose time. So we watch the schedule all day. Every truck must be on time.

That is cross-docking. We move the sugar, but we never keep it.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where do the inbound trucks arrive?
options: At the door on the right
At the door on the left
items.why: "The inbound trucks arrive there" — na porta da esquerda.

items.q: What do the workers do after they unload the pallets?
options: They put them on a shelf
They count them for a week
items.why: "Then they sort them — this group goes to São Paulo, that group goes to Santos."

items.q: How long is the sugar in the warehouse?
options: A few hours only at night
items.why: "the sugar is here for less than ninety minutes."

items.q: Why does Oliver watch the schedule all day?
options: Because a late truck stops the whole flow
Because the office asks for it
items.why: Inferência: "If one inbound truck is late, the whole flow stops" — por isso ele vigia os horários.

items.q: What does Oliver mean by "we move the sugar, but we never keep it"?
options: The sugar is not stored, only passed through
The sugar belongs to another company
The sugar is sold very fast
items.why: Inferência: a ideia do cross-docking é passar a mercadoria adiante sem armazenar.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The team will unload the truck in ten minutes." To unload means to…
options: put the goods on the truck
take the goods off the truck
items.why: To unload = descarregar, tirar a carga do caminhão.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We ___ the boxes by city before we send them."
items.why: To sort = separar / triar, aqui por cidade.

items.q: "The products never sit on a shelf." A shelf is…
options: a flat board to store things
items.why: Shelf = prateleira, onde se guardam as coisas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Cross-docking cuts the ___ cost because goods are not kept for long."
items.why: Storage cost = custo de armazenagem, reduzido no cross-docking.

items.q: "One late truck can break the whole flow." Here flow means…
options: the movement of goods through the process
items.why: Flow = fluxo, o movimento contínuo das mercadorias no processo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem no dia a dia da distribuição. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We will roll out cross-docking at all sites next year." To roll out means to…
options: start using it step by step
items.why: Roll out = implementar aos poucos, colocar em prática.

items.q: "The manager must sign off on the new schedule." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "If a truck is late, we have to keep up with the schedule." To keep up with means to…
items.why: Keep up with = acompanhar, manter o mesmo ritmo.

items.q: "Two drivers pushed back on the new times." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar.

items.q: "We agreed the plan, but the team did not follow through." They…
options: did not finish what they planned
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.
